verdict.rationale: Lovable exposes programmatic surfaces such as the Build with URL API and an MCP server, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not an interactive reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
